mostWorthwhile.text: Using the spindle to form two nuclei was most worthwhile: the time-strip connects chromosome separation to complete genomes while clearly showing that the cell has not yet split.

leastWorthwhile.text: Building the spindle felt less engaging as a decision because it was the only gameplay action offered, though the timing caption helped explain the preview.

surprise.text: The membrane supply travelled through the ER and Golgi in vesicles before fusing with the cell surface, making growth more concrete than simply combining lipids and proteins.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although the protein-and-centrosome combination relies on the result to identify tubulin and explain how spindle fibres form.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the clear sequence from DNA copying to separate daughter cells makes me curious how the later muscle and lining cells will develop.
